```plato
//==
// # Sampling
//
// Sections, in order:
//  - Sampled curves and surfaces
//  - Sampled fields on grids
//  - Regular grids
//  - Sample patterns
//  - Sample patterns in space
//  - Interpolation and resampling

//==
// # Sampled curves and surfaces
//
// Curves and surfaces recorded at discrete parameters rather than evaluated
// analytically: the discretized counterparts of the parametric forms, carrying
// their sample parameters so the original parameterization survives.

// A planar curve recorded at discrete parameters: Parameters and Points have
// equal length and Parameters ascend. Evaluation between samples
// interpolates linearly.
type SampledCurve2D
    implements IValue, IDeformable2D
{
    Parameters: Array<Number>;
    Points: Array<Point2D>;
}

// A spatial curve recorded at discrete parameters: Parameters and Points have
// equal length and Parameters ascend. Evaluation between samples
// interpolates linearly.
type SampledCurve3D
    implements IValue, IDeformable3D
{
    Parameters: Array<Number>;
    Points: Array<Point3D>;
}

// A surface recorded as a lattice of positions: Points holds one 3D position
// per (column, row) sample of the UV domain, with columns spanning U and
// rows spanning V uniformly across UvDomain.
type SampledSurfaceGrid
    implements IValue, IDeformable3D
{
    UvDomain: Bounds2D;
    Points: Array2D<Point3D>;
}

//==
// # Sampled fields on grids
//
// IField values stored one per grid node (lattice point), so each Values
// extent equals the grid's cell count plus one along that axis. Evaluation
// between nodes interpolates; outside the bounds, values clamp to the edge
// unless a resampling descriptor says otherwise.

// A planar scalar field stored on grid nodes; evaluation interpolates
// bilinearly. Backs heightmaps, masks, and discretized potentials.
type SampledScalarGrid2D
    implements IValue, IScalarField2D
{
    Grid: RegularGrid2D;
    Values: Array2D<Number>;
}

// A spatial scalar field stored on grid nodes; evaluation interpolates
// trilinearly. Backs voxel densities and simulation quantities.
type SampledScalarGrid3D
    implements IValue, IScalarField3D
{
    Grid: RegularGrid3D;
    Values: Array3D<Number>;
}

// A planar vector field stored on grid nodes; evaluation interpolates each
// component bilinearly. Backs 2D flow fields and displacement maps.
type SampledVectorGrid2D
    implements IValue, IVectorField2D
{
    Grid: RegularGrid2D;
    Values: Array2D<Vector2D>;
}

// A spatial vector field stored on grid nodes; evaluation interpolates each
// component trilinearly. Backs velocity volumes and deformation lattices.
type SampledVectorGrid3D
    implements IValue, IVectorField3D
{
    Grid: RegularGrid3D;
    Values: Array3D<Vector3D>;
}

// A planar color field stored on grid nodes; evaluation interpolates each
// channel bilinearly. An image with explicit world-space placement.
type SampledColorGrid2D
    implements IValue, IColorField2D
{
    Grid: RegularGrid2D;
    Values: Array2D<Color>;
}

//==
// # Regular grids
//
// Regular lattices over bounded regions: the axis-aligned cell decomposition
// that the discretized field and resampling descriptors of the other sections
// are defined against. Sampling
// metadata stays explicit so arrays of values retain their spatial meaning.

// A regular lattice of axis-aligned cells filling a planar bounding region.
// CellCounts gives the number of cells per axis; node counts are one greater
// per axis. Cell (0, 0) touches the minimum corner of Bounds
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Regular_grid).
type RegularGrid2D
    implements IValue
{
    Bounds: Bounds2D;
    CellCounts: IntegerVector2;
}

// A regular lattice of axis-aligned cells filling a spatial bounding region.
// CellCounts gives the number of cells per axis; node counts are one greater
// per axis. Cell (0, 0, 0) touches the minimum corner of Bounds
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Regular_grid).
type RegularGrid3D
    implements IValue
{
    Bounds: Bounds3D;
    CellCounts: IntegerVector3;
}

// One cell of a planar regular grid: its integer coordinates within the grid
// and its axis-aligned bounds in world space.
type GridCell2D
    implements IValue
{
    CellIndex: IntegerVector2;
    Bounds: Bounds2D;
}

// One cell of a spatial regular grid: its integer coordinates within the grid
// and its axis-aligned bounds in world space.
type GridCell3D
    implements IValue
{
    CellIndex: IntegerVector3;
    Bounds: Bounds3D;
}
```
